column4: Online courses allow students to study at their own pace.
column5: allow somebody to do something；pace 前用 their own，随主语改变代词。
column6: 在线课程怎样帮助时间有限的学生？

column4: Group projects can cultivate team spirit by giving each learner a clear responsibility.
column5: cultivate + 能力或品质；接 by doing 解释培养的途径。
column6: 合作项目如何改善学习体验？

column4: Schools can provide career guidance to help students make informed choices.
column5: provide + 事物 + to somebody；用 to do 说明目的。
column6: 学校除了教授知识，还能做什么？

column4: Practical training helps graduates develop expertise in their chosen field.
column5: expertise 通常不可数；in + 领域，不能写 an expertise。
column6: 实习如何帮助毕业生进入职场？

column4: Science courses teach students to analyse and interpret data before drawing conclusions.
column5: 两个并列动词共用 data；英式 analyse、美式 analyze 都可。
column6: 科学教育怎样训练判断力？

column4: Ethics lessons encourage children to distinguish right from wrong through discussion.
column5: distinguish A from B；right 与 wrong 在这里表示对错。
column6: 课堂讨论如何帮助道德教育？

column4: Interactive tasks can maintain students' interest when they serve a clear learning goal.
column5: 复数 students 的所有格在 s 后加撇号；避免只讲娱乐而忽略学习目的。
column6: 互动技术在什么条件下有帮助？

column3: 有效地浏览和使用互联网
column4: Digital literacy lessons help learners navigate the internet effectively and evaluate online sources.
column5: effectively 修饰 navigate；补充 evaluate sources 说明不是随意浏览。
column6: 学校为什么需要教授数字素养？

column4: Excessive gaming may lead to social disconnection if it replaces face-to-face activities.
column5: lead to + 名词或动名词；may 与 if 限定条件，避免绝对化。
column6: 过量游戏可能怎样影响社交？

column4: Changing roles can help employees develop multiple skill sets across different projects.
column5: skill sets 是技能组合；用 can 表示可能的益处。
column6: 适度变换岗位有什么潜在益处？

column4: Further training can help workers achieve specific career goals without changing employers.
column5: achieve goals；不要用 arrive goals。说明具体路径会更有说服力。
column6: 继续培训怎样帮助职业发展？

column4: Small firms may go out of business when operating costs rise sharply.
column5: 固定搭配 go out of business；不在 business 前加 a。
column6: 企业成本上涨会带来什么影响？

column4: Living alone may encourage young adults to solve problems independently.
column5: independently 修饰 solve；应同时考虑独居者可能需要的支持。
column6: 独居怎样影响年轻人的生活技能？

column4: Stable employment enables young adults to be economically independent.
column5: be + 副词 + 形容词；independent 可接 of somebody。
column6: 稳定就业怎样改变年轻人的生活？

column4: Shared households need clear agreements because residents have different living habits.
column5: habits 用复数；用 because 展示冲突背后的原因。
column6: 合住者如何减少日常摩擦？

column4: Partners should share responsibilities and undertake household chores fairly.
column5: undertake + 工作或责任；避免用性别推定某人的能力或职责。
column6: 家庭怎样分担无偿劳动？

column4: A practice can be the accepted social norm without being fair to everyone.
column5: norm 是社会规范，不等于自然规律；区分描述与价值判断。
column6: 为什么社会习惯仍可能需要改变？

column4: Fair recruitment policies should prevent discrimination against pregnancy.
column5: discrimination 通常不可数，against 引出被歧视的对象；实际写作也可更具体地说 pregnant workers。
column6: 招聘制度怎样减少性别不平等？

column4: Retired people with sufficient resources may make charitable donations to local organisations.
column5: make donations to + 机构；不要假设所有退休者都有经济余力。
column6: 老年人能以哪些方式参与社区？

column4: Flexible working arrangements can help carers seek career advancement while supporting older relatives.
column5: seek 后直接接名词，不加 for；advancement 一般不可数。
column6: 照护政策如何支持在职照护者？

column4: An experienced craftsperson can be a living repository of knowledge for younger learners.
column5: 比喻用法；repository of + 所储存的内容。可用具体经验支持观点。
column6: 代际交流有什么学习价值？

column4: Respectful travel can help visitors develop cultural sensitivity through contact with local residents.
column5: develop + 能力；cultural sensitivity 指理解并尊重差异。
column6: 旅行怎样促进跨文化理解？

column3: 沉浸在另一种语言环境中
column4: Exchange students can be immersed in another language through daily conversations.
column5: be immersed in + 环境；语境中的 be 跟在 can 后。
column6: 海外交流如何促进语言学习？

column2: get out of one's comfort zone
column4: Travelling alone can be a chance to get out of one's comfort zone.
column5: one's 是泛指占位语；实际写作可按主语换成 my、their 等。
column6: 独立旅行怎样挑战已有习惯？

column4: Clear advertisements can attract potential consumers by explaining a product's practical benefits.
column5: attract somebody；by doing 交代方式，不要把销量增长当作必然。
column6: 广告如何帮助新产品进入市场？

column4: Consistent messages can shape brand image over time.
column5: shape 作动词；brand image 为名词搭配，可按语境加 a company's。
column6: 重复的广告信息怎样影响品牌认知？

column4: A growing advertising sector may create job opportunities for designers and writers.
column5: job opportunities 为复数；指出具体岗位，避免笼统断言。
column6: 广告产业可能带来哪些就业机会？

column3: 让缺少表达渠道的人发声
column4: Local journalism can give voice to the voiceless by reporting neglected community concerns.
column5: give voice to + 人或诉求；the voiceless 是一个群体表达。
column6: 地方新闻如何帮助被忽视的社区？

column4: Selective reporting may manipulate public opinion by omitting relevant evidence.
column5: opinion 在此通常不可数；用 may 和具体机制说明风险。
column6: 选择性报道如何影响公众判断？

column3: 久坐的生活方式与肥胖
column4: Health discussions often link a sedentary lifestyle and obesity, but the relationship involves several factors.
column5: 两个并列名词概念；论证健康问题时不要把相关性直接写成单一因果。
column6: 讨论久坐问题时为什么需要谨慎？

column4: Automated routine checks can save manpower and time for small firms.
column5: save + 资源；明确 routine checks，避免宣称所有工作都应自动化。
column6: 自动化怎样影响重复性任务？

column4: Rapid automation may result in unemployment if displaced workers receive no retraining.
column5: result in + 结果；区别 result from + 原因。
column6: 自动化在什么条件下可能损害就业？

column4: Online seminars allow researchers to exchange ideas without geographical limitations.
column5: without + 名词短语；仍可补充网络连接、时区等实际限制。
column6: 在线交流如何扩大学术合作范围？

column4: Space missions can collect research data about distant planets.
column5: data 与 research 构成名词搭配；交代收集什么数据比泛谈科技更具体。
column6: 太空探测如何产生科学价值？

column4: Open access to satellite observations may speed up scientific progress in climate research.
column5: speed up + 进程；说明资源怎样用于研究。
column6: 共享卫星观测数据有什么价值？

column4: Large space programmes require long-term commitment and funding from their sponsors.
column5: 并列名词 commitment and funding；long-term 作定语要有连字符。
column6: 太空项目为什么需要长期规划？

column4: Accessible public education can help reduce economic inequality over time.
column5: help + 动词原形；over time 限定过程，不承诺立刻消除差距。
column6: 公共教育怎样支持机会公平？

column2: lessen the financial burden on parents
column4: Subsidised childcare can lessen the financial burden on parents who work full time.
column5: burden on + 承担者；lessen 表示减轻，不等于完全消除。
column6: 托育补贴如何帮助家庭？

column4: Targeted scholarships can widen access to university for people from disadvantaged backgrounds.
column5: people from + 背景；避免把群体标签当作个人能力的判断。
column6: 助学金应该关注哪些障碍？

column4: International partnerships can grant scholarships to students with limited financial resources.
column5: grant scholarships to somebody；说明资助对象和目的。
column6: 国际教育援助怎样支持当地人才？

column4: Aid projects can build sanitation facilities where safe water and waste treatment are lacking.
column5: build + 设施；sanitation 涉及卫生与排污，不仅是医院。
column6: 基础卫生援助应关注什么？

column4: Locally designed training programmes can generate economic opportunities beyond the period of foreign aid.
column5: generate opportunities；用 beyond 强调援助结束后的持续性。
column6: 援助怎样支持长期发展？

column4: Cleaner transport can reduce the overuse of fossil fuels in crowded cities.
column5: overuse of + 资源；fossil fuels 通常用复数。
column6: 城市交通政策如何减少能源压力？

column4: Reusable packaging can reduce non-biodegradable trash in household waste.
column5: non-biodegradable 修饰 trash；trash 不可数，英式也常用 rubbish。
column6: 可重复使用包装能解决什么问题？

column4: Some discarded materials may take centuries to decay under certain environmental conditions.
column5: take + 时间 + to do；具体材料和环境会改变分解速度。
column6: 为什么应谨慎处理持久性废物？

column2: minimize the pain experienced by animals
column3: 尽量减少动物经历的疼痛
column4: Research protocols should minimize the pain experienced by animals and consider suitable alternatives.
column5: experienced by 是过去分词修饰 pain；美式 minimize、英式 minimise 均可。
column6: 动物研究应怎样控制伤害？

column4: Animals kept in shelters should be treated in humane ways.
column5: humane 是人道的，区别 human（人类的）；被动结构 be treated。
column6: 收容机构应如何对待动物？

column4: Carefully designed research may lead to important medical breakthroughs, but ethical safeguards remain necessary.
column5: lead to + 名词；收益与伦理约束需要分别论证。
column6: 如何平衡研究价值与伦理要求？

column4: Families facing difficulty in making ends meet may need accessible social support.
column5: difficulty in doing；make ends meet 是收支相抵、维持生计。
column6: 社会支持可以回应哪些经济压力？

column4: Crime prevention requires attention to complicated socioeconomic issues as well as individual responsibility.
column5: socioeconomic 同时涉及社会与经济；不要把贫困与犯罪直接画等号。
column6: 为什么犯罪预防不能只依赖惩罚？

column4: Supportive mentors can help teenagers avoid situations in which they might succumb to peer pressure.
column5: succumb to + 压力或诱惑；to 是介词。
column6: 导师支持怎样帮助青少年作出选择？

column4: Support for minority languages can help maintain cultural diversity.
column5: maintain + 状态；用具体政策连接抽象价值。
column6: 少数语言支持为什么有意义？

column2: provide a sense of identity and belonging
column3: 带来身份认同与归属感
column4: Community festivals can provide a sense of identity and belonging for local residents.
column5: a sense of + 抽象名词；identity and belonging 共用 sense of。
column6: 社区节日怎样连接人们？

column4: Carefully managed heritage tourism can promote local economic development without overwhelming residents.
column5: promote + 发展；without doing 可说明政策边界。
column6: 文化遗产旅游如何兼顾经济与居民？

column4: International agreements may remove trade barriers while retaining necessary safety standards.
column5: remove + 障碍；while 表示两项目标可以并存。
column6: 国际合作怎样促进贸易往来？

column4: Cultural festivals can create more job opportunities for local performers and small businesses.
column5: more 比较级需有比较基准；说明哪些群体可能受益。
column6: 文化交流活动能怎样支持当地就业？

column4: Community workshops can raise the awareness of preservation among local residents.
column5: 原资料使用 the awareness；更常见的自由写作表达是 raise awareness of heritage preservation。
column6: 文化交流怎样带动遗产保护？

column4: Public art can provide an aesthetic experience in places people use every day.
column5: aesthetic 以元音音素开头，前用 an；用具体场景展开观点。
column6: 公共艺术可以怎样进入日常生活？

column4: Well-maintained cultural venues can improve a city's image and serve local residents.
column5: 单数 city 的所有格为 city's；公共价值不应只等于宣传价值。
column6: 文化场所怎样改善城市生活？

column2: realize the importance of arts research
column3: 认识到艺术研究的重要性
column4: Studying the history of design can help students realize the importance of arts research.
column5: realize + 宾语；英式 realise 也可。说明研究怎样形成理解。
column6: 艺术史学习能怎样支持研究意识？
